project: PolyULife full application observation and Figma reconstruction
objective: Use Computer Use to observe and analyse every PolyULife interaction, then reproduce the complete application as a clickable Figma prototype.

historical_context.description: Earlier work reported successful installation, application launch and homepage AX reading. This is context for revalidation, not evidence of current screen visibility, screenshots or business-flow completion.

findings.observed_fact: Clearing the room field left No room found visible; submitting the empty query returned to the initial state.
findings.hypothesis: A user may read the stale result as belonging to the empty field. No participant confusion has been measured.
findings.principle: Visibility of system status: distinguish the submitted query from the editable query.
findings.suggestion: Evaluate explicit submitted-query context or clearing the result when the input is cleared.

findings.observed_fact: One click on a green available time-slot card produced no visible change.
findings.hypothesis: Card styling may imply selectable details to some users; this is not evidence of a broken booking feature.
findings.principle: Affordance and feedback: appearance should communicate whether the item is informational or actionable.
findings.suggestion: If informational, evaluate a clearly labelled availability table; if actionable, verify expected action and feedback first.
requires_validation: Test a second slot with reliable hit target
Ask real participants what they expect

findings.observed_fact: Preview loaded a webpage near its top; a downward scroll revealed Room: AG206 and its photographs. Closing Preview retained the Room filter.
findings.hypothesis: Unrelated page header/intro may add effort before users reach the selected room; actual user cost is unmeasured.
findings.principle: Match between system and user goal; continuity of context on return.
findings.suggestion: Evaluate a direct room-content anchor while retaining room/date/filter context on return.
requires_validation: Repeat to see whether initial scroll position is stable
Verify room content below the photograph

findings.observed_fact: After Sun selection a screenshot briefly showed the old 29-Sep result; a later observation showed 04-Oct with No available room, without another Search click.
findings.principle: Visibility of system status during asynchronous updates.
findings.suggestion: Represent both the observed transition and settled state; do not label the transient mismatch as a confirmed defect.
requires_validation: Repeat the change with captured loading feedback before drawing latency or usability conclusions

findings.observed_fact: A text link in the weather article opens the official Academic Registry website in an embedded browser, with a cookie notice.
findings.hypothesis: The transition may require users to recognise a different website context; no participant confusion has been observed.
findings.principle: Consistency and visibility of system status across an embedded web handoff.
findings.suggestion: Preserve a clear webpage context and verify a reliable close/return path in the prototype.
requires_validation: Inspect the actual close feedback and cookie controls
Observe real users locating the policy and returning

findings.observed_fact: Hero expand opens an image overlay; X restores the weather article.
findings.principle: User control and freedom through a reversible overlay.
findings.suggestion: Reproduce both expand and close; a static enlarged image does not reproduce this flow.
requires_validation: Inspect any other image gestures separately
